scope: Isolated localhost harness with real headless Chromium, IndexedDB, tabs and WebCrypto. No product UI or physical device acceptance.

checks.name: Actual IndexedDB retains exact PNG bytes, raw form text and original pending command across reload
Two actual tabs reject stale writes while exact lost-save acknowledgements preserve the same revision
Current account keys are separate and a foreign copy cannot replace the current account draft
Explicit local clearing compares the reviewed revision and fingerprint and preserves another account draft
Separate new and exact group slots retain independent original bytes, pending commands and editor slots across actual reload; legacy key remains unchanged
Exact-slot replay and clearing preserve sibling slots, and a copy cannot be written under another slot
Actual clear and recreation retain a monotonic slot revision and reject the old tab ABA write while preserving the new bytes
Actual persisted byte corruption is rejected after public hashes are recomputed; original in-memory bytes remain available
Simulated IndexedDB denial preserves a complete downloadable original and pending command
checks.condition: Injected browser storage denial; not a real quota measurement
